subject: SecureGuard MDM/EDR/VulnScan Renewal - pricing, SOW, and timeline
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@secureguard.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 09:32:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal notice: MDM + EDR + Vulnerability Scanner (account: Redwood Inference)

Hi Mina and Hiro,

Hope you both are well — reaching out on behalf of SecureGuard. Your annual subscription for our Endpoint Management (MDM), EDR agent, and Vulnerability Scanning bundle is up for renewal on 2026-04-15. We wanted to share the renewal quote and check whether you want to renew the current bundle or take advantage of our new endpoint analytics add-on.

Attached: SecureGuard_Renewal_Quote_2026.pdf (pricing, seat counts, term options).

Key summary:
- Current list: 1,200 endpoints (MDM + EDR) + 2 vulnerability scanners (monthly scans)
- Renewal term options: 12 months / 24 months (pricing tiers in PDF)
- New add-on: Endpoint Analytics (extra $0.35/endpoint/month; trial available)

If you prefer, I can prepare a revised quote scoped to a 24-month committed term and include a draft SOW for corporate procurement/legal review. Do you have a preferred time for a 30-minute renewal call next week?

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Account Executive, SecureGuard
alex.chen@secureguard.io
Mobile: +1-415-555-0198

On Sun, 1 Mar 2026 at 09:32, Alex Chen <alex.chen@secureguard.io> wrote:
> Attachment: SecureGuard_Renewal_Quote_2026.pdf
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal notice: MDM + EDR + Vulnerability Scanner (account: Redwood Inference)

Thanks Alex — looping in infra, finance, procurement, and legal to assess. Hiro/Vivek/Kimberly/Monica: summary from SecureGuard attached above.

Quick asks from our side before we commit:
- Hiro: any telemetry or feature changes in the EDR agent in the past year that would require re-testing? Will the new Endpoint Analytics change data retention?
- Kimberly: request for a draft SOW and confirmation of the indemnity/DSAR clauses — we should see the SOW early so legal can comment.
- Vivek/Monica: can procurement finance a 24-month commit? If we go 24m, what kind of discount should we target (SecureGuard referenced tiered pricing)?

I can take the lead on the renewal call and ask Alex for a 24-month quote and an editable SOW. Proposed time: Thu 3/4 10:00am PT or Fri 3/5 2:00pm PT — which works?

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Security Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@secureguard.io>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Talia Brooks <talia.brooks@sec-consulting.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal notice: MDM + EDR + Vulnerability Scanner (account: Redwood Inference)

Thanks all — confirmed for Thu 3/4 10:00am PT. I've attached an updated quote scoped for a 24-month commitment with a proposed 14% multi-year discount and included the Endpoint Analytics add-on as an optional line. Also included a draft SOW for legal to review (SecureGuard_SOW_draft_2026.docx).

DocuSign link for expedited signing after approvals: https://docusign.com/secureguard/ds-12345

Notes on agent/telemetry: the EDR 4.7 agent we deployed last year had a small telemetry schema change (additional process metadata). No changes to encryption or retention defaults. Endpoint Analytics stores aggregated telemetry for 90 days by default; retention can be configured. Happy to have Talia from Secure Consulting join the call to talk migration/testing.

Attachments: SecureGuard_Renewal_Quote_2026.pdf, SecureGuard_SOW_draft_2026.docx

—
Alex Chen
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal notice: MDM + EDR + Vulnerability Scanner (account: Redwood Inference)

Thanks for sharing the draft SOW. A few redlines from Legal:
- Confirm that SecureGuard will maintain SOC 2 Type II and provide the most recent report annually (we need the report attached before signature).
- Limitations on liability: propose cap at 1x annual fees for standard procurements (we can negotiate higher for managed services).
- Data processing: require subprocessor list and commitment to notify 30 days prior to any changes.

Monica/Hiro/Mina: please confirm whether we need an internal exceptions packet or additional data flow diagrams. I will mark the SOW with tracked changes and upload to our shared Drive when done.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal notice: MDM + EDR + Vulnerability Scanner (account: Redwood Inference)

Reviewed the updated quote and legal redlines. Finance is OK to fund a 24-month commitment at the proposed 14% discount plus the Endpoint Analytics add-on (we'd like the add-on trial for 30 days at no charge). Please confirm final numbers after legal and infra sign-off.

Budget note: charge code to use is ENGINEERING:SEC:2026:MDM. Monica — can procurement trigger the PO and accept the DocuSign once legal gives the green light?

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@secureguard.io>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal notice: MDM + EDR + Vulnerability Scanner (account: Redwood Inference)

All — thanks for the quick turn. Legal redlines look reasonable; Hiro confirmed the agent change is not a blocker and will run a smoke test during the trial window. Finance approved funding. Monica: please move forward with the PO and accept the 24-month DocuSign after you confirm SecureGuard attaches the latest SOC 2 report and accepts the liability cap language Kimberly proposed (we can accept 1x annual fees).

Action items:
- Monica: create PO with charge code ENGINEERING:SEC:2026:MDM and coordinate signature via DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/secureguard/ds-12345
- Kimberly: upload SOW with tracked changes to the shared Drive (link to follow) and confirm SOC 2 attachment is present before signature.
- Hiro: run smoke test during the 30-day Endpoint Analytics trial and report any regressions to Alex/Talia.
- Alex/Talia (SecureGuard): please enable the 30-day Analytics trial and attach SOC 2 report to the DocuSign package.

If all items are met, proceed to sign by EOD 3/15 to avoid service lapse.

Thanks,
Mina
Security Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Attachments referenced: SecureGuard_SOW_draft_2026.docx, SecureGuard_Renewal_Quote_2026.pdf
